assets.name: ink-puddle-blue-glossy-v78
assets.title: Sky blue ink puddle
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent 2D overhead ground sprite for a colorful glossy mobile world map. Create ONE small pool of SKY BLUE INK, viewed straight from directly above, orthographic. Shape: a softly asymmetric upright kidney / peanut silhouette, two large rounded lobes joined by a gently pinched waist, slightly taller than wide. Match the simple readable craftsmanship of a polished candy mobile map pond: saturated clean cyan-blue liquid center, a slim darker teal meniscus at upper/left edge, a thin pale aqua curved lower edge giving shallow recessed liquid depth, ONE large smooth white-to-pale-blue crescent reflection hugging the upper-left interior. Chunky smooth glossy liquid, restrained very smooth blue gradient, clearly readable at 60px. Centered complete silhouette with 12 percent transparent margin. Actual transparent background everywhere outside liquid. No scenery, no grass, no container, no bottle, no splashes, no drops, no rocks, no bubbles, no glitter, no text, no ground shadow, no black outline, no grain, no photoreal water, no ripples or swirls. The puddle is a flat shallow ground patch, not a raised jelly bean or a bowl. All visible liquid surface opaque.
